20261121-physics-g05-2.title: Imoto idlule kwindawo yolawulo lwesantya

20261121-physics-g05-2.material: Imoto idlule kwindawo yolawulo lwesantya kwindlela enkulu (umgama opheleleyo we-30 km) ngemizuzu eyi-15. Sisantya esiphakathi sale moto singakanani ngeekhilomitha ngeyure?
20261121-physics-g05-2.s.s1.prompt: Imoto idlule kwindawo yolawulo lwesantya kwindlela enkulu (umgama opheleleyo we-30 km) ngemizuzu eyi-15. Sisantya esiphakathi sale moto singakanani ngeekhilomitha ngeyure?

20261122-physics-g06-1.title: Usetyenziso oluqhubekekayo
20261122-physics-g06-1.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Usetyenziso oluqhubekekayo ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261122-physics-g06-1.material: [Usetyenziso oluqhubekekayo] Xa ujonga oonobumba beendaba ngeglasi yokukhulisa (ilensi ephakamileyo) usondele kakhulu, oonobumba babonakala bekhulu bemile mpo, kodwa xa uyikhupha kude, oonobumba bonakala bejike. Kutheni bebonakala bemile mpo xa usondele?
20261122-physics-g06-1.s.s1.prompt: [Usetyenziso oluqhubekekayo] Xa ujonga oonobumba beendaba ngeglasi yokukhulisa (ilensi ephakamileyo) usondele kakhulu, oonobumba babonakala bekhulu bemile mpo, kodwa xa uyikhupha kude, oonobumba bonakala bejike. Kutheni bebonakala bemile mpo xa usondele?
20261122-physics-g06-1.s.s1.explain: Xa into ingaphakathi komgama wofokhasi welensi ephakamileyo, imigca yolwandiso lokukhanya okugobileyo iyadibana yenze umfanekiso ongelona wenyani omkhulu kunento nomileyo mpo (umfanekiso ongelona wenyani omileyo okhulisiweyo).
20261122-physics-g06-1.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga ngendlela yokukhanya xa into isondele kunomgama wofokhasi.
20261122-physics-g06-1.s.s1.hint.1: Kuba ukukhanya kuyasasazeka, kufuneka kudwetshwe umgca wolwandiso ngasemva kwelensi ukuze kudibane.
20261122-physics-g06-1.s.s1.o.o0: Kuba oonobumba babekwe ngaphakathi komgama wofokhasi welensi ukuze kubonwe umfanekiso ongelona wenyani okhulisiweyo nomileyo mpo
20261122-physics-g06-1.s.s1.o.o1: Kuba ukukhanya kubuyiselwa njengesipili kumphezulu welensi
20261122-physics-g06-1.s.s1.o.o3: Kuba umphunga emoyeni uyilushushisile ilensi yeglasi yokukhulisa

20261122-physics-g06-2.title: Yintoni isizathu sesayensi sokuba kungaze
20261122-physics-g06-2.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Yintoni isizathu sesayensi sokuba kungaze ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261122-physics-g06-2.material: Yintoni isizathu sesayensi sokuba kungaze kuchukunyiswe iplagi yombane okanye isiphakamisi sesixhobo sasekhaya ngesandla esimanzi?
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.prompt: Yintoni isizathu sesayensi sokuba kungaze kuchukunyiswe iplagi yombane okanye isiphakamisi sesixhobo sasekhaya ngesandla esimanzi?
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.explain: Xa isikhumba simanzi, ukumelana kombane komzimba kuyehla kakhulu ukuya kwixabiso elincinci kunokuqhelekileyo, kwaye nangeevolthi ezincinci, umbane obulalayo uhamba emzimbeni ubangele iingozi zokubetha ngombane.
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.hint.0: Ngokungafaniyo namanzi acocekileyo, amanzi esiwasebenzisa yonke imihla anee-electrolyte ezinyibilikileyo.
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.hint.1: Isandla esimanzi sibangela ukumelana kwesikhumba kwehle kakhulu umbane uhambe lula.
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.o.o0: Kuba iiyoni ze-inorganic ezinyibilikile emanzini zenza umbane uhambe lula nobungozi bokubetha ngombane bukhula kakhulu
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.o.o1: Kuba iconsi lamanzi liyipholisa iplagi liyenze ibe ngumkhenkce
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.o.o2: Kuba isandla esimanzi sivelisa amandla emagnethi
20261122-physics-g06-2.s.s1.o.o3: Kuba umbane ubangela amanzi asesandleni ahwabe onke
